Then run `pnpm vitest related --run` on the touched source and test files, after building the workspace packages if the runtime tests need the built catalog.
7. Run `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm run typecheck` on the touched packages, then `pnpm action:build`, because catalog and runtime/src changed. Commit the rebuilt packages/action/dist/ with the change.
